correctness.rationale: For every full binary tree over n pairwise different variables the dynamic trace count vector is computed exactly by the three-cell convolution from the published Nmatrix. Polynomial expansion yields associator (0,-v_1*(u_1*w_k-u_k*w_1),v_k*(u_1*w_k-u_k*w_1)); the symmetric plane u_1=u_k is closed and diagonalizes under u_0 and u_0+3u_1, giving the all-n formula. On either face bc=0 the relevant operation is deterministic. Left-comb minus balanced on four leaves equals bc(b-c)^2, positive iff both unequal positive weights. n<=3 shape-independent by commutativity. Independently replayed standard-library checker confirms 29537 finite assertions, including all legal labels to five leaves and associator on 19683 count triples. Limit: finite checks support but do not prove unrestricted claim.

value.rationale: For symmetric nondeterministic choice, root possibilities alone are associative and therefore hide internal nondeterministic branching cost. Counting local valuation histories answers a distinct natural quantitative model-semantics question. The theorem gives complete weighted input regimes for bracketing invariance, an all-size exact formula at balanced weights, and the smallest possible sharp witness when the condition fails. This is a structural boundary for a newly introduced operation, not an arbitrary numerical slice, claim of broad process-algebra semantics or generic code artifact.
